# ghost_team (Data Source)

Looks up a team in an organization, by `slug` or by `id`, with its members and the repositories it can reach. Teams can't be created with a personal access token, so there is no `ghost_team` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By slug. Ghost matches it case-insensitively, but it changes when the team
# is renamed.
data "ghost_team" "core" {
  organization = "my-org"
  slug         = "core"
}

# By ID, which never changes.
data "ghost_team" "by_id" {
  organization = "my-org"
  id           = "DG4eRcoHLcE1RfixZDetBcBzEQBBYIbb"
}

# Let the team bypass a ruleset.
resource "ghost_repository_ruleset" "protect_main" {
  repository  = "my-org/my-repo"
  name        = "protect-main"
  enforcement = "active"

  conditions = {
    ref_name = {
      include = ["~DEFAULT_BRANCH"]
    }
  }

  bypass_actors = [
    { actor_type = "Team", team_id = data.ghost_team.core.id, bypass_mode = "pull_request" },
  ]

  rules = {
    deletion = true
  }
}

output "core_team_members" {
  value = [for m in data.ghost_team.core.members : m.username]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The slug of the organization the team belongs to. Ghost matches it case-insensitively. The token's user must be a member of the organization.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The team's ID. It never changes, so prefer it over `slug` to keep finding a team that may be renamed. It is what `team_id` arguments, such as `ghost_repository_ruleset` bypass actors, take. Set exactly one of `id` and `slug`.
- `slug` (String) The team's URL-safe name, used in URLs and `@org/team` mentions. Ghost matches it case-insensitively. It changes when the team is renamed, so a lookup by `slug` breaks on rename; look up by `id` to avoid that. Set exactly one of `id` and `slug`.

### Read-Only

- `maintainers` (List of String) The usernames of the team's maintainers, sorted.
- `members` (Attributes List) The team's members, sorted by username. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `name` (String) The team's display name.
- `repositories` (Attributes List) The organization repositories the team has a role on, sorted by slug. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))
- `viewer_can_manage` (Boolean) Whether the token's user may change the team's members: an organization admin or one of the team's maintainers.

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `image` (String) The member's avatar URL, null when they have none.
- `maintainer` (Boolean) Whether the member is a team maintainer, who may manage the team's members.
- `name` (String) The member's display name.
- `username` (String) The member's username.


<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `full_name` (String) The repository's full name, `organization/slug`, with `organization` spelt as configured. Pass it to the `repository` argument of other resources.
- `name` (String) The repository's display name.
- `role` (String) The team's role on the repository: `read`, `triage`, `write`, `maintain` or `admin`.
- `slug` (String) The repository's slug.
- `visibility` (String) Either `public` or `private`.
